_note: Mail-side defaults for the walkinmail skill. drafts_subfolder empty => drafts land in the MAIN Drafts folder (so the webmail shows them as normal editable/sendable drafts). Set a name (e.g. 'Walk-in') to nest under Drafts instead. Env vars override: INFOMANIAK_IMAP_HOST, INFOMANIAK_IMAP_PORT, INFOMANIAK_WALKIN_SUBFOLDER, INFOMANIAK_DRAFTS_PARENT. Auth lives in .env (INFOMANIAK_IMAP_USER, INFOMANIAK_IMAP_PASSWORD).
